item.title: The Quantum Sword, Honed by AI
item.description: Bitcoin continues to pull back toward $76k, with the market waiting for tonight’s US CPI print. The threat quantum computing poses to Bitcoin — a sword that has hung overhead for a long time — has seen some fresh movement.

item.title: Fortress Guarded, Yet 4,000 BTC Stolen
item.description: Bitcoin has been pulling back lately, with macro headwinds pushing it down to around $77k. A few days ago, something quietly unsettling happened on Liquid — Bitcoin’s federated sidechain.
